items.title: 706 SE 2nd Street Delray Beach, FL
items.description: Introducing "Villa Montecito," an extraordinary waterfront estate in the heart of Delray Beach's coveted Marina Historic District, a newly reimagined architectural masterpiece that embodies the pinnacle of modern coastal luxury. Ideally positioned on 120 feet of direct Intracoastal frontage within an uncommon and highly desirable no-wake zone, this gated compound offers unrivaled privacy and tranquility just two blocks from Atlantic Avenue and less than one half mile from the beach. Completed in June 2026 after an extensive four-year redesign and renovation, Villa Montecito has been transformed into a world class estate of uncompromising quality and sophistication. Originally constructed in 2010, the residence was meticulously expanded and curated by the acclaimed Warwick Design Group of Los Angeles, renowned for crafting bespoke interiors for celebrities, business leaders, and distinguished clientele. Envisioned in the California Transitional idiom with Spanish influences, the residence underwent a sweeping reconfiguration of its footprint, yielding a graceful flow and a layout attuned to family living. Its bedrooms were reimagined and expanded, with particular devotion to the ensuite baths and closets. Beneath the polished finishes, the entire home has been re-engineered, with new electrical, plumbing, and climate-control systems throughout. Exceptional materials from California, Europe, and Japan have been thoughtfully gathered throughout the residence, lending it a rare distinction in craftsmanship and refinement. Honed Italian marble and natural quartzite grace the interiors, and no engineered surface appears anywhere within. In the primary baths, the showers are clad in majestic slabs of Calacatta Caldia and Statuary marble, while the guest baths are appointed with Carrara honed marble tile and countertops, complemented by freestanding vanities. Discreetly set behind a motorized solid-iron gate and approached by a roughly 200-foot brick paved driveway, the property spans approximately 22,682 square feet across more than half an acre of impeccably groomed grounds. A grandfathered 10-foot wall, no longer permissible under current code, encircles the site, creating a seclusion seldom found in East Delray Beach. As the gates close behind you and the palms sway gently along the waterfront, the compound feels less like a residence and more like a retreat hidden within one of South Florida's most vibrant destinations. Comprising 12,778 total square feet, 9,271 of them under air, the residence offers seven bedrooms, eight full bathrooms, and two half baths, all shaped by Montecito-inspired architecture and contemporary flair. Soaring ceiling heights ranging from approximately 9 to 13 feet create a remarkable sense of openness and natural light throughout the home, while custom solid-wood doors and bespoke built-in cabinetry showcase an extraordinary level of craftsmanship. The cabinetry and closets are distinguished by Blum European concealed hardware, dovetail construction, soft-close action, and vertical-grain European oak in tailored finishes. A rebuilt stairwell, crowned by an iron railing designed expressly for the residence, welcomes natural light, while a fireplace adds warmth. Imported white oak flooring from Spain, in eight-inch planks, stretches from threshold to threshold, complemented by Waterworks plumbing fixtures, cabinet hardware, and accessories that lend quiet distinction to the kitchen and baths. The chef's kitchen was conceived for lavish entertaining and seamless daily living, equipped with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, among them a professional-grade six-burner range with double ovens, griddle, and grill, along with matching Miele dishwashers and dual full-height wine refrigerators. A butler's pantry and two beverage stations complete the culinary suite with quiet sophistication. Whether hosting intimate dinners or large celebrations, the space blends functionality with graceful form at every turn. A series of expansive formal and informal living spaces create an atmosphere equally suited for sophisticated entertaining and relaxed waterfront living. The residence includes a dramatic formal living room, elegant dining room, full lounge and club room with bar, private movie theater/media room, and a spectacular temperature-controlled wine room with capacity for more than 3,000 bottles, an extraordinary showcase for collectors and connoisseurs alike. Walls of glass and expansive French doors blur the distinction between indoors and outdoors, allowing soft sea breezes and glittering vistas to become part of the everyday. The oversized loggia overlooks the Intracoastal Waterway, a resort-style pool and spa, and expertly cultivated landscaping, creating an idyllic setting for sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, and evenings illuminated by the reflection of yachts passing quietly along the channel. Outdoor amenities include a fire pit, a cabana, and an Alfresco BBQ area with its own refrigeration, all set among entirely renewed plantings. Designed for the boating enthusiast, the private waterfront accommodates multiple vessels, with berths for a pair of boats aided by a 24,000-pound lift, in addition to a dedicated platform for three jet skis. The sheltered position ensures calm waters and convenient access to the ocean and South Florida's premier waterways. No detail was overlooked in the extensive modernization. Additional features include a fully integrated Crestron smart-home automation system, full-home water filtration system, updated elevator, five garage bays including a vehicle lift, fully turfed grounds, and meticulously designed landscape lighting and irrigation systems. Even the resort style pool and spa are finished in exquisite, imported cobalt-blue Fujiwa tiles from Japan, adding another layer of bespoke international design to the estate's exceptional aesthetic. Villa Montecito represents a rare opportunity to acquire one of Delray Beach's most significant waterfront properties, a private sanctuary where world-class design, modern technology, timeless coastal elegance, and the effortless romance of waterfront living converge just moments from the celebrated dining, boutiques, galleries, and nightlife of Atlantic Avenue.

items.title: 4846 ORLEANS Court B West Palm Beach
items.description: This 3-bedroom, 2-bath villa in the 55+ Community of Forest Glen offers 1,312 square feet of single-story living in West Palm Beach with waterfront access. The open floor plan flows across vinyl wood-look flooring and neutral walls, anchored by a kitchen appointed with white shaker cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and stone countertops. The primary spaces feature contemporary ceiling fans and recessed lighting throughout. Both bathrooms include updated vanities and tub-shower combinations. The well-maintained exterior showcases a green facade with white shutters and established lawn space. This villa delivers move-in ready comfort with the added value of waterfront proximity in an established community.

items.title: 3123 Oakland Shores Dr
items.description: Charming second floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located in a well-maintained two-story gated community surrounded by lush, open green spaces. Conveniently situated just 5 minutes from I-95, offering easy access to shopping, dining, and beaches. This bright and spacious unit features tile flooring throughout, generously sized bedrooms, and a primary suite with a walk-in closet. Enjoy relaxing on your screened-in porch complete with pull-down privacy shades. The community is pet-friendly and offers excellent amenities including a clubhouse, swimming pool, fitness center, BBQ area, and more. Laundry facilities are available on each floor, plus an additional storage room. Investor-friendly property with no rental restrictions! Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to own in a secure, amenity-rich community. Contact Listing Agent for more information

items.title: 495 Brickell Ave
items.description: Stunning high-floor residence on the 50th floor of Icon Brickell Tower II offering 2 bedrooms plus a den and 2 full bathrooms with breathtaking panoramic views of Biscayne Bay, the Atlantic Ocean, and the downtown Miami skyline. Enjoy spectacular vistas from the living room, primary suite, and private balcony. The versatile den offers the potential to be converted into a true third bedroom with the addition of a door and closet. Over $30,000 in recent upgrades include fresh interior paint, new recessed ceiling lighting throughout, updated kitchen and dining light fixtures, a redesigned primary bedroom entry for improved functionality and flow, modern matte black hardware throughout, new electrical outlet covers, and a custom oversized mirror in the primary bathroom. Furniture is available for purchase separately, offering a turnkey opportunity if desired. Experience resort-style living at Icon Brickell with world-class amenities in one of Miami's premier waterfront communities, just moments from Brickell City Centre, fine dining, shopping, and entertainment.

items.title: 1301 COPLEY Court Boynton Beach, FL 33436
items.description: This very bright, 2-story townhouse is located in the quiet and highly desirable Wellesley at The Meadows with breathtaking lake views from every room. Beautifully renovated, it features vaulted ceilings, stainless steel appliances, and quartz countertops. The skylight and windows in the living room bring in lots of natural light and give an open feeling. This corner unit offers a private entry, a screened patio, a new metal roof installed in 2019, impact windows. Wellesley at The Meadows is a gated community with a 24-hour manned security gate, a heated community pool, and tennis courts. This pet-friendly community offers lots of open green space and walking paths, perfect for enjoying the outdoors. Close to shopping, restaurants, and services. Easy access to i95.

items.title: 9826 Turning Bluff Lane Boynton Beach
items.description: Beautiful Venice model (3/3.1+den+3cg) on private lot backing south. Features include impact windows, contemporary elevation w/marble accents, etched glass entry door & sidelite, 24" porcelain floors, solid core doors, custom wall moldings, wallpapers, window treatments, light fixtures, fans & built-ins, hi-hats, custom closets, upgraded baths & more! Kitchen has European white gloss cabinets, quartz countertops w/full height backsplash, gas cooktop, stainless hood, double oven, island/snack bar w/contrasting cabinetry and much more! The great room has bar with wine fridge. Large primary suite. Luxurious primary bath w/zero-entry shower. Two ensuite guest bedrooms-one with Murphy bed. Den has built-in desk unit with storage. Lushly landscaped backyard has extended patio with covered area. This home is located in Valencia Grand, a premier 55+ lifestyle community featuring a spectacular 44,000 square-foot clubhouse and top notch (nearly) 9-acre recreational facility. Endless activities and opportunities for fun abound - there are activities, trips, shows, and clubs of all types. The clubhouse features an elegant foyer and lobby, a grand ballroom with raised stage and dance floor, three spacious card rooms, a sports lounge with billiard tables, poker tables and golf simulator, a full service restaurant with indoor/outdoor seating, a poolside bar with happy hours at the poolside bar, an arts and crafts center, a catering kitchen and cooking studio, an exercise studio with ping pong, a fully equipped fitness center and men's and women's locker rooms with steam rooms and showers, an outdoor yoga garden, Mind and Body Spa for everything from hair to nails to facials to massages and more! There are four pools - a beautiful Resort-style pool and Shade Pavilions, Lap pool, Resistance walking pool, Grandchildren's wading pool, and an Outdoor whirlpool spa. There are six har-tru tennis courts with shade pavilions and lighting for night play, tennis pro shop and shaded tennis and pickleball seating areas, tennis pro, league play, four indoor pickleball courts, seven outdoor pickleball courts, pickleball pro, league play, 4 bocce courts with intramural play and walking/jogging/biking paths just outside the community. Valencia Grand is conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, houses of worship and major highways!

This villa delivers move-in ready comfort with the added value of waterfront proximity in an established community.

items.description: Corner Unit, 2/1 & 1/2 Bathroom, Corner 3rd Floor. AC is about 10yrs old Spacious bedroom with plenty of storage space. Can include some furniture plus 2 58 in Samsung TV's . items.title: 32801 US HIGHWAY
items.description: STUNNING SUNSETS • 3-BEDROOM, 3-BATH HOME • INDIAN HAMMOCK HUNT & RIDING CLUB Experience the very best of the Indian Hammock lifestyle at Lot 121, featuring a beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home in one of Okeechobee's most unique private gated communities. This home has been thoughtfully renovated, and The result is a fresh, modern and inviting retreat that is ready for you to move in and enjoy. One of the property's most special features is its incredible setting and spectacular sunset views. Whether you're looking for a full-time residence, a weekend escape or a private Florida retreat, lot 121 provides access to an unmatched outdoor lifestyle. Indian Hammock Hunt & Riding Club offers an exceptional outdoor lifestyle. Nearly 2600 Acres of common land with equestrian facilities and riding trails, hunting areas, fishing ponds, archery and shooting facilities, clubhouse, pool, tennis, fitness amenities and a private airstrip.

VILLA FEATURES A SPACIOUS KITCHEN, LAMINATE FLOORING IN LIVING/DINING ROOM AREAS WITH AN UPDATED MASTER BEDROOM AND LARGE WALK-IN CLOSET. UNIT HAS A VERY LARGE ENCLOSED PORCH AND WASHER/DRYER IS ON PREMESIS (NOT IN UNIT). LIVING/DINING ROOM HAS OPEN FLOOR PLAN WITH LOTS OF NATURAL LIGHTING. $491/M MAINT FEE (WLL BE DECREASING IN 2027), $3,000/Y- TAXES AND MARKET RENTS OF $1800-$2000 CREATES A 8-10% RETURN FOR THE SAVVY INVESTOR TO ADD THIS TO THEIR INVESTMENT PORTFOLIO. SMALL COMMUNITY OF JUST 9 VILLAS IN A VERY HIGH RENTAL DEMAND LOCATION. PROPERTY NEEDS SOME WORK TO MAXIMUM ROI. items.title: 20225 NE 34th Ct
items.description: THIS IS THE CONDO YOUR CLIENTS HAVE BEEN WAITING FOR! THE KITCHEN OFFERS GREAT LIGHTING WITH STAINLESS STEEL APPLIANCES INCLUDING A STACKABLE WASHER/DRYER & CERAMIC FLOORING. THE 2 LARGE BEDROOMS HAVE GREAT CLOSET SPACE WITH UPDATED BUILTINS. LAMINATE FLOORING THROUGHOUT MAKES IT FOR EASY LIVING. THERE ARE HURRICANE SHUTTERS FOR ADDED SECURITY COVERING EVERY WINDOW AND BALCONY DOORS. THE BUILDING WAS RECENLTY RENOVATED TO COMPLY WITH THE 40YR CERTIFICATION AND THE SELLER HAS PAID THE ASSESSMENT IN FULL. THE PROPERTY IS LOCATED IN AN *A* RATED SCHOOL DISTRICT. THE BUILDING HAS GREAT SECURITY INCLUDING A 24HR MANNED GUARD GATE, VALET AND FRONT DESK LOBBY SECURITY. OTHER AMENITIES INCLUDE BIKE STORAGE, STORAGE LOCKER, BARBECUE AREA, SAUNA AND JACUZZI, HEATED POOL, GAME ROOM, TENNIS, LIBRARY, PARTY ROOM, FITNESS CENTER, AND SO MUCH MORE. ALSO, AS A RESIDENT OF AVENTURA, YOU'LL HAVE FULL ACCESS WITHIN WALKING DISTANCE TO FOUNDERS PARK WHICH OFFERS A FUN PLAYGROUND, TENNIS AND PICKELBALL AND SOCCER FIELDS. THE SELLER IS VERY MOTIVATED AND INVITES ALL REASONABLE OFFERS. THIS UNIT IS MOVEIN READY!! ENJOY THE GOOD LIFE!!

items.title: 3123 Oakland Shores Dr
items.description: Charming second floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located in a well-maintained two-story gated community surrounded by lush, open green spaces. Conveniently situated just 5 minutes from I-95, offering easy access to shopping, dining, and beaches. This bright and spacious unit features tile flooring throughout, generously sized bedrooms, and a primary suite with a walk-in closet. Enjoy relaxing on your screened-in porch complete with pull-down privacy shades. The community is pet-friendly and offers excellent amenities including a clubhouse, swimming pool, fitness center, BBQ area, and more. Laundry facilities are available on each floor, plus an additional storage room. Investor-friendly property with no rental restrictions! Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to own in a secure, amenity-rich community. Contact Listing Agent for more information

items.title: 398 NE 5th St
items.description: Fabulous 2 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom Hotel/Condo Unit Located in the Heart of Downtown Miami. This Unit Features a Full Kitchen with All Appliances, is Completely Furnished with Modern Furniture and Flat Screen TVs. King Size Beds and Pull Out Couch for Extra Room. Unbelievable Southeast Miami Views of Miami Beach and Biscayne Bay. This Unit is Also Wheelchair Accessible. This Hotel Condo Features a Wrap Around Pool, Two Story Gym, Valet Parking and So Much More! Location Offers Easy Access to Kaseya Center, Bayside Marketplace, All Major Roadways, Port of Miami, Public Parks and Public Transportation! Don't Miss This One! The Quarterly Maintenance is $3,805.85.

items.title: 495 Brickell Ave
items.description: Stunning high-floor residence on the 50th floor of Icon Brickell Tower II offering 2 bedrooms plus a den and 2 full bathrooms with breathtaking panoramic views of Biscayne Bay, the Atlantic Ocean, and the downtown Miami skyline. Enjoy spectacular vistas from the living room, primary suite, and private balcony. The versatile den offers the potential to be converted into a true third bedroom with the addition of a door and closet. Over $30,000 in recent upgrades include fresh interior paint, new recessed ceiling lighting throughout, updated kitchen and dining light fixtures, a redesigned primary bedroom entry for improved functionality and flow, modern matte black hardware throughout, new electrical outlet covers, and a custom oversized mirror in the primary bathroom. Furniture is available for purchase separately, offering a turnkey opportunity if desired. Experience resort-style living at Icon Brickell with world-class amenities in one of Miami's premier waterfront communities, just moments from Brickell City Centre, fine dining, shopping, and entertainment.

items.title: 3330 NW 101st St Miami, FL 33147
items.description: BRAND NEW CONSTRCUTION HOME TO BE STARTED MID COTOBER 2026 AND BE COMPLETED END OF JANUARY 2027. COME SEE OUR GREAT COMPLETED MODELS LOCATED NEAR BY AND HAVE YOUR BUYERS FALL IN LOVE WITH THE ADVATANGE OF A BRAND NEW HOME WITH NO ASSOCIATION FULL OF EXTRAS. STAINLESS STTEEL APPLIANCES OPEN FLOOR PLAN AND SPACIOUS BACKAYARD. VERY CLOSE TO EAST HIALEAH. CALL LA FOR EASY INSTRUTCTIONS

items.title: 1301 COPLEY Court Boynton Beach, FL 33436
items.description: This very bright, 2-story townhouse is located in the quiet and highly desirable Wellesley at The Meadows with breathtaking lake views from every room. Beautifully renovated, it features vaulted ceilings, stainless steel appliances, and quartz countertops. The skylight and windows in the living room bring in lots of natural light and give an open feeling. This corner unit offers a private entry, a screened patio, a new metal roof installed in 2019, impact windows. Wellesley at The Meadows is a gated community with a 24-hour manned security gate, a heated community pool, and tennis courts. This pet-friendly community offers lots of open green space and walking paths, perfect for enjoying the outdoors. Close to shopping, restaurants, and services. Easy access to i95.

items.title: 9826 Turning Bluff Lane Boynton Beach
items.description: Beautiful Venice model (3/3.1+den+3cg) on private lot backing south. Features include impact windows, contemporary elevation w/marble accents, etched glass entry door & sidelite, 24" porcelain floors, solid core doors, custom wall moldings, wallpapers, window treatments, light fixtures, fans & built-ins, hi-hats, custom closets, upgraded baths & more! Kitchen has European white gloss cabinets, quartz countertops w/full height backsplash, gas cooktop, stainless hood, double oven, island/snack bar w/contrasting cabinetry and much more! The great room has bar with wine fridge. Large primary suite. Luxurious primary bath w/zero-entry shower. Two ensuite guest bedrooms-one with Murphy bed. Den has built-in desk unit with storage. Lushly landscaped backyard has extended patio with covered area. This home is located in Valencia Grand, a premier 55+ lifestyle community featuring a spectacular 44,000 square-foot clubhouse and top notch (nearly) 9-acre recreational facility. Endless activities and opportunities for fun abound - there are activities, trips, shows, and clubs of all types. The clubhouse features an elegant foyer and lobby, a grand ballroom with raised stage and dance floor, three spacious card rooms, a sports lounge with billiard tables, poker tables and golf simulator, a full service restaurant with indoor/outdoor seating, a poolside bar with happy hours at the poolside bar, an arts and crafts center, a catering kitchen and cooking studio, an exercise studio with ping pong, a fully equipped fitness center and men's and women's locker rooms with steam rooms and showers, an outdoor yoga garden, Mind and Body Spa for everything from hair to nails to facials to massages and more! There are four pools - a beautiful Resort-style pool and Shade Pavilions, Lap pool, Resistance walking pool, Grandchildren's wading pool, and an Outdoor whirlpool spa. There are six har-tru tennis courts with shade pavilions and lighting for night play, tennis pro shop and shaded tennis and pickleball seating areas, tennis pro, league play, four indoor pickleball courts, seven outdoor pickleball courts, pickleball pro, league play, 4 bocce courts with intramural play and walking/jogging/biking paths just outside the community. Valencia Grand is conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, houses of worship and major highways!

items.title: 1270 42nd Avenue Vero Beach, FL 32960
items.description: Perfect as a primary residence, second home, or investment property, this beautifully updated Vero Beach pool home features a 2022 roof, impact windows, renovated bathrooms, LVP flooring, and an open-concept floor plan with a spacious kitchen and huge center island. Enjoy Florida living year-round with a heated screened pool, large covered lanai, and east-facing backyard perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Situated on a huge corner lot, the property offers a circular front driveway plus a second rear driveway leading to an air-conditioned 576 sq. ft. two-car garage with a bonus room, perfect for a home office, gym, or hobby space. Plenty of room for your boat, RV, toys, and extra vehicles, plus a dedicated RV power hookup and dump station. Located in an established neighborhood

items.title: 1660 1660 NE 191ST Street
items.description: Motivated Owner 2/2+converted additional bedroom. Spacious 1,674 sq. ft. 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, plus additional bedroom/den for extra living space. This waterfront condo is located in the gated Jade Winds - Allamanda Gardens community. The floor-through design creates excellent flow and allows abundant natural light throughout the home. Enjoy beautiful waterfront surroundings from the comfort of your private covered balcony, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The unit features a modern kitchen, spacious bedrooms, new flooring throughout, and an in-unit washer and dryer. The generous living areas provide plenty of space for comfortable everyday living. Located just 10 minutes from Aventura Mall, with an abundance of restaurants, . Assessment paid in full!

items.title: 121 Eleuthera Dr Dania Beach, FL 33004
items.description: Enjoy a great DANIA BEACH location at 121 Eleuthera Dr.! This lightly used, snowbird-owned home offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, & flexible space with potential for a 3rd bedroom if needed. RARELY AVAILABLE FOR SALE ON THE OPEN MARKET. A perfect opportunity for seasonal enjoyment or year-round living in sunny South Florida. Larger than tax roll shows at 1,040 total living area sq ft. Split floorplan design with rear master bedroom and forward guest bedroom. Private covered patio in the rear along with side carport shed for extra storage. COMPLETE ALUMINUM SHUTTERS & BRAND-NEW central HVAC. Fully furnished sale for easy transition. Beautiful, mature oak tree lined street. Well established Co-op community with low monthly dues. This property is a full Shareholder in Ocean Waterways. Offers CLUBHOUSE with a private pool & shuffleboard. Able to rent property for up to 7 months during season. 55+ neighborhood. AMAZING LOCATION: Around the corner to Dania Pointe shops & restaurants, 3 miles to HOLLYWOOD BEACH, 3 miles to Hardrock Hotel & Casino, and 2 miles to Fort Lauderdale / Hollywood International airport. YOUR SOUTH FLORIDA ESCAPE BEGINS HERE!

items.title: 9006 Maywood Cir Lehigh Acres, FL 33935
items.description: Nearly Half an Acre in a great part of Port LaBelle! This oversized 0.42-acre residential lot offers an exceptional amount of space for the area, giving you plenty of room to build your future Florida home and enjoy the privacy that comes with a larger homesite. With no HOA, this property is a great opportunity to own a substantial piece of Southwest Florida. Enjoy the peaceful lifestyle of Port LaBelle while remaining approximately 45 minutes from Fort Myers and just over 2 hours from Miami, with beaches, shopping, dining, and entertainment within easy reach. Whether you’re ready to build or looking for a land investment, lots of this size are a rare opportunity in the area.

items.title: 730 47TH Street West Palm Beach, FL
items.description: Welcome to this stylish single-family home featuring an open-concept layout, quality finishes, and abundant natural light. The spacious kitchen offers modern appliances, custom cabinetry, and sleek countertops, flowing into comfortable living and dining areas. Generously sized bedrooms include a private primary suite with an en-suite bath and walk-in closet. High-end flooring, designer lighting, and thoughtful finishes add to the home's appeal. Enjoy a private outdoor space ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located near Flagler Drive and the area's growing collection of dining, entertainment, and residential developments, this home offers both comfort and a convenient location.

items.title: 15962 Wildflower CT Palm Beach, FL
items.description: Welcome to the stunning pool home nestled on a rarely available cul-de-sac pie-shaped lot spanning nearly half an acre. features an oversized expansive Pool and Spa, making it the perfect oasis for relaxation and entertaining. offering 6 bedrooms plus a versatile office/den that can easily be transformed into a 7th bedroom. With 4.5 bathrooms and a 4-car garage. Are you tired of constantly paying high electric bills? This home features a whole house solar system that can help you slash your monthly expenses. With an estimated bill of less than $30 per month and a 20-year warranty on both the system and the roof, The solar system, provided by Sun Run, one of the largest residential solar providers in the US. Say goodbye to expensive electric bills and hello to a brighter, more energy-efficient future with this solar-powered home. The oversized backyard is truly one-of-a-kind with a free-flowing pool complete with a hot tub spa with spa jets, sun deck, LED lights, and a salt system all controlled by the Jandy RS Pool & Spa Automation system. The Master bedroom overlooking the pool and lake plus a built-in closet and a den/office on the first floor, while all other bedrooms and loft are on the second floor. laminate flooring throughout, a large and open eat in kitchen with a butler's pantry, a custom hood vent and the kitchen island is enhanced with charming black board and batten, with granite counter tops, built in oven microwave and gas cooktop. Make this dream home yours!

items.title: Open House Sat, Oct 17, 11 AM 1 / 11 $249,900 Single Family Residence For Sale Active 3 BEDS 2 TOTAL BATHS Ocala, FL 34473 Marion Oaks Subdivision
72 2801 N Pine Island Road N
items.description: BEST UNIT, BEST PRICE, Welcome to this Bright 2 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom Condo with Gorgeous and Peaceful Lake Views. Walk-In Closets for both bedrooms and more than ample space.
